verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a networking and VPN connectivity platform. Having an AI agent analyze pull requests and suggest code improvements is a code-review capability outside its product category. The nearby evidence (a Tailscale skill for coding agents, the Aperture LLM gateway and CLI, and remote access from a phone) only covers connectivity and routing for agents, not PR analysis, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone
